sessionInactive: The OpenXR session is no longer active
diagnosticUnavailable: Diagnostic visualization is unavailable for this OpenXR session
layerNotRegistered: Layer manifest is no longer registered in that OpenXR slice
layerConflict: Another VectorXR registration is already enabled ({slice}: {path}). OpenXR apps crash when two copies of VectorXR load, so disable that one first.
elevationRequired: This OpenXR layer change requires elevation. Restart VectorXR as administrator, then try again.
elevationCanceled: OpenXR layer change was canceled at the elevation prompt or the elevated helper did not start.
